_help: Optional real audio. Leave it empty and the game uses its built-in synthesized sound. See docs/AUDIO.md. 'track': ONE finished song that loops for the whole game and gets louder and brighter as each wick is lit: put the file in this folder and set the name here, currently "audio/looper_tihar.ogg"; leave it empty to fall back to the generated score. 'stems': five loops of the SAME length (layer 1 = drone only ... layer 5 = full), played in sync; they win over 'track' if both are listed. 'sfx': name of an effect (click, chime, caw, flap, light, jump, land, collect, hit, yelp, bark, slide, paper, whoosh, note, fanfare, bell, fail, step, cowbell, footprint, shimmer, perfect, tick) -> file in this folder.
